name: John Creedon
role: Candidate for constable in Billings County, 1886
bio: John Creedon was a candidate for constable on both the Stockmen's ticket and the Billings County ticket for the spring 1886 county election, listed beside J. B. Harmon, Fred Banan and J. W. Tompkins. He received 87 votes in the April 1886 returns.
